votes.motion: Approve the Work Session minutes of Tuesday, May 12, 2020; Tuesday, May 26, 2020; Tuesday, May 28, 2020 and Formal Meeting minutes of Tuesday, January 5, 2021 and Tuesday, January 19, 2021.
votes.description: Approval of multiple prior work session and formal meeting minutes spanning May 2020 and January 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items B1-B3 to a future consent agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on three grant applications (CMAQ East Downtown 200 South Transit Hub, Assistance to Firefighters Fire Equipment, and Justice Court Online Virtual Platform) and refers them to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a later date (Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2020-21).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Library Fund budget amendment for FY2020-21 and defers Council action to a later date.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a later date (Zoning Text Amendments for Off-street Parking).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on proposed zoning text amendments to off-street parking regulations and defers Council action to a later date.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action until related amendments such as the Affordable Housing Overlay or Residential Housing Loss Mitigation Plan are brought to the Council for consideration and potential adoption (RMF-30 Text Amendment).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the RMF-30 Low Density Multi-Family Residential zoning text amendments and delays final action until related affordable housing measures are ready for Council consideration.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 3 of 2021, for the West End Alley Vacation (Adjacent to Properties at 740 West and 746 West 900 South).
votes.description: Approves the vacation of a small portion of an alley adjacent to 740 West and 746 West 900 South to allow the petitioner to square off a corner of their property for future multi-family residential and commercial development.

votes.motion: Defer action to a future Council Meeting (Zoning Map Amendment at 706-740 West 900 South and 710-739 West Genesee Avenue).
votes.description: Postpones Council action on the proposed rezone of properties from M-1 to R-MU at the West End site to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 4 of 2021, for the Zoning Amendments at approximately 2903 South Highland Drive.
votes.description: Approves amendments to the Sugar House Master Plan and zoning map for 2903 South Highland Drive, changing the eastern portion from Low Density Residential to Low Intensity Mixed Use and from R-1-7000 to CB zoning.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 5 of 2021, for a rezone at 1301 and 1321 South State Street.
votes.description: Approves rezoning 1301 and 1321 South State Street from CC (Corridor Commercial) to FB-UN2 (Form Base Urban Neighborhood 2) to allow for potential mixed-use development.

votes.motion: Reject the petition for zoning amendments at Lincoln Street and 200 South.
votes.description: Denies the petition to rezone properties at 159 South Lincoln Street and 949-963 East 200 South from R-2 to RMF-35, consistent with the Planning Commission's negative recommendation.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda (setting public hearing dates for Budget Amendment No. 7 FY2020-21 and One-Year Action Plan for CDBG and other federal grants FY2021-22).
votes.description: Approves the consent agenda, which sets April 6, 2021 as the public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 7 and the One-Year Annual Action Plan for CDBG and other federal grant programs for FY2021-22.
